steps.title: Analyze build logs for errors
steps.description: Examine the processDebugResources failure to identify incompatible attributes.

steps.title: Locate accessibility_service_config.xml error
steps.description: Determine that 'typeAllMasks' is an invalid flag for accessibilityEventTypes; standard correct value is 'typeAllMask'.

steps.title: Fix accessibility service resource flags
steps.description: Update accessibilityEventTypes to use 'typeAllMask' to resolve the AAPT error.

steps.title: Clean build.gradle dependencies
steps.description: Remove unused nanohttpd dependency from app/build.gradle to ensure full compliance with internal SDK only rule and improve speed.

steps.title: Verify build configurations
steps.description: Confirm targetSdkVersion, compileSdkVersion, package name, and XML namespaces are fully matching and correct.

steps.title: Building Virtual Mouse Touchpad
steps.description: Compile, package, and build the final installable debug APK for Virtual Mouse Touchpad.
